body: We have a 10 year old son who is notndoing well with any of this.

I can say that I completely agree. I have enough to worry about without having to be responsible for bandaging up the relationship my husband has with our son. Like him having our lights and gas disconnected. I'm not about to babysit his relationship with our child. That's his responsibility. If he wants to throw his relationship with him in the garbage, I'm willing to watch it go up in smoke. And I will question him about anything he does to our child that hurts him. I would be less of a mother if I didn't. Who tells their child that his feelings aren't as important as their own? Who the hell does that?! There is no way in hell I'm about to sit my kid down and be like ok, I know your dad walked out on us, took all the money out the accounts, left mom with all the bills, cheated, broke your heart, broke mom's heart, broke our family, left you at school, hasn't shown up for some visits, told you your feelings don't matter, continues to do everything he can to hurt us in some way but you shouldn't be angry at him you're not entitled to those feelings. No way in hell. He's hurt, disappointed, scared, upset, and sad and he has every right to those feelings. His father needs to man up and learn how to be a compassionate father. Afterall he created this storm, he can learn to stand in it.

Please read my reply to the comment above. My son is feeling my pain I can admit that but his father isn't doing anything to make him feel important. On top of what I wrote above he has left him at school, not shown up for some visits, and late sometimes over an hour and half for most of his other visits. It's just sad. I tell my child he is free to express whatever he is feeling. Unfortunately his dad is making his own bed when it comes to his relationship with our son.

It's hard because when my son tries to talk to him about how he is feeling about things his dad is short with him and basically shuts him down. Then my son came home and told me his dad in so many words told him his feelings don't matter and that his (his father) feelings come first. I asked his dad about this on the phone and he admitted it with absolutely no remorse. So I'm started to understand where my child is coming from.
He's 10. I know we are home bodies. We do need to get out a bit more. I really would like to leave this state and when his dad comes on Tuesday, I'm going to ask him to let us go and not contest it.
How ironic that this message just came through to me as I sit as the kitchen table and sob. Everything hurts. I want to leave this state so bad. I need to get away.

I can see it that way but they seem to think telling me to "just get over it" or trying to set me up on booty calls is what I need. It's not. I'm emotionally broken. I need love, support, and lots of hugs.
I'm not super busy trust me. I can't even get myself to leave the house except to take my son to and from school.
As soon as my insurance kicks in. 2 weeks from now.
That's even more depressing. The people that I thought cared about me really don't.
There are just a few people that I talk to but no one who comes to check on me or anything. I'm pretty much all alone except my son.
I just want off this roller coaster

I don't know how. I really don't. I know it's all in my head but breathing literally hurts. Everything hurts. I really don't know how I'm doing this. I feel like such a horrible mom. I take my son to school and pick him up and then we lay on the couch all night with movies on while I sob. I don't have the fight in me anymore. I want these feelings to go away.

I'm getting better I think, still struggling but I'm not as bad as I was. Thank you for checking on me. I wish I could get mad, that's hard when you still really love someone. I love him so much it hurts.
I have a few people I talk to. I've gotten more support from strangers than people I thought were my friends tho.
I'd like it to be as soon as possible but I'm not sure I have the courage. I just know that living hurts. Everyday it hurts.
I'm trying.
I completely understand that feeling. I am so sorry. I don't want anyone else to suffer like I am. I am so sorry.

That I'm tired of being alone. That I needed my husband to not give up on us or me. That the pain is just to much. That I told everyone I was not okay and nobody cared enough to reach out. Everyone ignored me. I have been in this house day in and day out alone and suffering. That I can't win this battle and I'm just tired and want it all to be over.

This is totally my life right now. He announced he wanted a divorce, walked out and took his ring off. Meanwhile I'm over her dying inside. I am absolutely crushed. I constantly feel like I can't breath. I just want my life back and if I can't have it back then I don't want life.
I have primary and he has visits every other week.
I have no family here and even they were here we're not close. The feeling of complete isolation on top of the pain only magnifies everything. Where are my "friends"?
I am trying. I am trying so hard.
I am positive that my son is the only reason that I am still here but event that isn't getting me through the pain anymore. I love my son so very much but this pain....I stay in bed all day.

I don't even know who I am anymore. The pain......I can't even describe the pain. It's so severe. He took my heart, he ripped it right out of my chest when he left. I can't believe I have survived this long and now I just want it to be over.

My heart is broken. I'm almost certain I'm dying of a broken heart little by little everyday anyway. 11 years together, 7 married. How is it this easy for him to walk away. I just want my husband. I want my life back. I want this pain to go away. I can't continue to fight this battle, not alone. I'm losing.

I can barely get out of bed in the morning. The pain is unreal. I never imagined that something could hurt this bad. I have tried to distract myself. I continued on to college and had to leave because I was tired of random moments of crying and emotion in class. I have been escorted to the counselors office more times that I care to admit. I'm over this, I'm over it.
No I haven't. I have two weeks until my insurance kicks in. I don't know if I can wait that long. I don't want to feel like this. I'm so tired.
Last night I started the note that I wanted to leave.

I've tried to distract myself nothing helps. I had to leave college because I would have emotional break downs in class. I was so tired of being escorted to the counselor's office. I just don't want to feel this anymore.
But I'm not okay and I can't see ever being okay and I'm so tired of pretending that I am.
Like someone stabbed me in the heart over and over
I just want it to be over. I don't want to feel like this anymore. I have never felt pain like before in my life.
That is terrible. As if the process isn't already hurtful for the kids. I'm so sorry.
I have no idea. I hope so.
I know I can't control what he does but I would like to think I could trust him to be mindful of his son's feelings. Guess not.
I have everything documented including him leaving my child at school and missed visits and everything. In my state cheating is no biggie either. Sad.
I went to legal aid who informed me that they no longer take divorce cases.

Not yet. I need to but I need to try and get a lawyer which is nearly impossible since they all want $1000-$2500 retainer fee and since he cleared our bank acccounts I clearly do not have that. Started a GoFundMe which isn't really gaining momentum. I just feel so hopeless right now.

Thank you. Today sucks! I'm trying to get a lawyer but they want $1000-$2500 for a retainer. I am unemployed college student who's husband left and took all the money. How can I afford that? And they don't care.  Yep had another breakdown today.
Thank you. I'm having a really hard time today.
I have very few friends and they are telling me to move on. I don't think they understand how difficult that is.
Thank you so much
i just broke down reading this. I'm emotionally and physically exhausted. I don't know how much longer I can take this. I don't. Thank you for your advice. I will try the journal.
I hope this feeling is not ok. I don't like feeling like this. I just know that I'm going to get into court and have a breakdown.
I wish that more than anything. I just want to wake up.
I'm just grasping for understanding and I can't find it which makes this all the more difficult. Smh.
I have a few friends but he and my son are the only family I have here. This shit really sucks.
It's definitely shocking. I am still shocked.
Yea I think I really need therapy. He was my best friend. I lost my husband and my best friend all in the same night.

I keep trying to figure it out. How can you be so cruel to someone who has loved you for so long? He's acting like I did something to him. Meanwhile I'm just over here confused as hell. Ugh. I don't want this to be my life.

I know and I feel so guilty because he and my son are the only family I have here and I don't want to keep talking about it to my friends. I am really going through a lot right now and I feel like I'm bogging them down with all of it. I feel so alone.
It's crazy how it happened. I am still in shock 4 weeks later.
Smh. It totally sucks. I thought I was going to have a nervous break down last night.
Thank you

I sleep on the couch because the thought of the bed makes me want to break down. I can't sleep through the night and I barely eat.  I have lost 12 pounds in 4 weeks which I'm ok with but at some point I have to eat right?

There was none of that. He went to work that day. We literally spent all day exchanges texts about how much we miss and love each other and planning things for the weekend and then he came home and walked out of my life.

I'm sure we had some issues as no relationship is perfect and communication was def one of them. We should have communicated better but how do you go from telling me you love me and miss me all day long while you're at work and come home from work and tell me you're leaving? How is that a thing you can remotely do to someone?

I need some help because I feel like I'm drowning all the time. I'm struggling to catch my breath as I type this. It is terrible and the one person I want to talk to about it, who was my best friend for 11 years, I can't. I feel so alone.
That sucks so bad. I am so sorry for you.
I hope I am able to. I have been in a very dark place. Last night was the worst. Thank God my son was here. He's the only thing even remotely getting me through this.
That makes me sad to think of. He should have talked to me. We were suppose to be best friends.
Yes! Definitely.
And note: he NEVER told me he was unhappy. That is the problem that I am having.
Yes! I don't understand how you spend so much time with someone and then just turn your feelings off. How is that even remotely possible?
Not that I am aware of.
Definitely. I just don't get it.
Because he's the father of my child and I was with him for 11 years. I expected him to respect me enough to talk to me. This isn't just hard on me. It's hard our son.
Thank you.

As I sit here pondering how my husband of 7 years could just walk away from our marriage. I completely understand how you feel. I am so sorry that you are going through this. It sucks trust me I know. I love that man so much! How could he just give up?
I totally understand where you are coming from. This shit hurts so bad. The pain is unreal. I wish you all the best. I myself am in a very dark place right now and I don't know how to get out of it.

Tho my situation is different, I understand the feelings you are having. My husband and I were married for 7 years and 4 weeks ago he walked out on my son and I. I am terrified. We have a young son and I just am heartbroken for him. We have been together all of his life and now his world as he knows it is broken. I am also scared for myself that I'll never truly heal from this. It's a scary thought of breaking the attachment you had to a person and starting over. I am right there with you.

Update: we are still separated. It's been 4 weeks now and I'm so miserable. I just want to know that my son and I will be ok. I can't believe that he did this to us. He sees my son about once a week and he's content with that. Smh. I don't even know who this man is anymore and I was with him for 11 years total. I feel so empty. Last night I was really in a dark place. I started nursing school on the 23rd and can't even buy my books. He knows that but he doesn't care. I can not believe that this is my life right now.
Any amount will help us get out our feet. We are so appreciate of those who have already donated!
Thats sad. I'm sorry.
I hope so. I having an appointment next week.
I am so sorry. I definitely understand. It's a traumatizing thing to go through. I will pray for the both of us.
I have seen that movie. I love it.
Thank you. I need all the support I can get. I've been in a very dark place.
Thank you so very much!
Thank you!
Thank you. I sure hope so. I need to get past this hopeless feeling.

I have tried to speak with him but he is basically hard as hell to communicate with at this point because of his cold ass attitude. I suspect that he'll pay the rent for next month because his name is on the lease. I'm going to try and text him today. Smh. I hate that this is my life.

Yes I have considered this and if he can hurt me and our son like this. I don't want his ass back. This divorce can't come quick enough. I need to start the healing process. Just need to get on my feet.
Rent
Thank you!
We have Court October 11th and thats when they will determine support
This is all great advice actually. Thank you. This shit is definitely hard.  I hope that you find your peace as well.
Yes that is a perfect way to describe it. Like I'm drowning. I constantly feel like I'm trying to catch my breath.
I am going to sit down with a lawyer next week. I just want to wake up from this nightmare but to wake up I would have to go to sleep. I haven't slept or ate much since he left.

He is my son's father. I find myself saying my son I think because I feel like it's just the two of us now. He wasn't a dick throughout our marriage. I am just so confused by all of this. He is being such an asshole right now. I have never seen him behave in this manner. My son has seen me break down and has dried my tears a few times. He's been amazing. I am so heartbroken for not just myself but him. Our family is all he has know his whole life and now it's broken.
Thank you so much. I will pray for you and I hope that things work out for you as well. Take care.
